privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: We respect your privacy. This site does not use cookies for advertising or tracking.
privacy.p2: If you send us a request or a message, we use the information you provide only to handle it and contact you. We don't share it with third parties without your consent, unless the law requires it.
privacy.p3: We keep data from closed requests for no more than twelve months, then remove the personal details.
privacy.p4: For any question about your data, or to ask us to delete it, reach us through the contact page.
